title: Head of School, Therapeutic Setting
summary: Lead a small, nurturing, trauma-informed school for children and young people with SEMH needs.
body:
## The position

Bright Futures is proud to be working in partnership with a specialist education provider to recruit a Head of School for a therapeutic setting in Essex.

It's a unique opportunity to lead a small, nurturing school supporting children and young people with SEMH needs and associated challenges. The provision takes a trauma-informed, therapeutic approach, with a strong focus on relational practice, personalised learning and holistic development.

As Head of School you'll take full responsibility for day-to-day leadership and operational management, shaping the school's vision, driving improvement and ensuring consistently high standards across education, behaviour and safeguarding. Working alongside a wider leadership and therapeutic team, you'll lead a multidisciplinary staff group and create an environment where pupils and staff thrive.

## The role

- Lead the overall running of the school, ensuring a safe, structured and nurturing environment.
- Drive high standards in teaching, learning and behaviour support.
- Embed a strong therapeutic, trauma-informed ethos across the provision.
- Oversee safeguarding and pupil wellbeing as the highest priority.
- Lead, support and develop staff, promoting accountability and professional growth.
- Ensure compliance with Ofsted and regulatory standards.
- Manage budgets, resources and staffing effectively.
- Build positive relationships with families, local authorities and external stakeholders.
- Contribute to strategic development and school improvement planning.

## About you

We're looking for an experienced, values-driven leader with a passion for working with vulnerable learners.

### Essential

- Qualified Teacher Status (QTS).
- Senior leadership experience in a school (for example Deputy Head, Head of School or equivalent).
- Experience working with SEMH, SEND or alternative provision.
- A strong understanding of safeguarding and behaviour frameworks.
- Experience of Ofsted inspections and driving school improvement.
- The ability to lead and motivate multidisciplinary teams.

### Desirable

- NPQH or an equivalent leadership qualification.
- A SENCo qualification or strong SEND knowledge.
- Experience in therapeutic or trauma-informed environments.
- An understanding of EHCP processes and local authority commissioning.
